candidates.source_name: Finweek Bratislava — Speakers page
candidates.why_relevant: Largest SK fintech/banking conference (10th edition 13-14 Oct 2026, Jurkovicova Teplaren). Speaker cards carry person name + employer and frequently exact job title (verified examples: 'Dusan Jurcak, Executive Director, Narodna banka Slovenska'; 'Peter Penzes, Head of Crypto-assets and Innovation Section, NBS'; 'Oleg Pittner, Tatra banka'). A dated roster of who holds which function in SK banking/payments.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual + quarterly HTML scrape of /speakers/ and archived editions; diff name/title/employer triples year-over-year to detect new functions and moves.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk-language search on conference program terms, then direct fetch
queries_used: Finweek konferencia Bratislava 2026 program recnici banky

candidates.source_name: Finweek Bratislava — Agenda / Program
candidates.why_relevant: Session-level agenda pairs panel topics (payments, digital euro, regulation) with named panellists and their employers; a first-time title such as 'Head of Instant Payments' on a panel is direct evidence of a new function at a SK institution.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape agenda pages before/after each edition (programme is published progressively through the year); snapshot repeatedly to capture late additions.
queries_used: Finweek konferencia Bratislava 2026 program recnici banky

candidates.source_name: Finweek Bratislava 2026 — Eventbrite listing
candidates.why_relevant: Mirror of the conference agenda with dates and session descriptions; useful as a fallback when the organiser site changes structure, and Eventbrite search is itself a pointer to smaller SK fintech meetups.

candidates.source_name: ZBK — Zdruzenie pre bankove karty, Podujatia (events)
candidates.why_relevant: The Slovak bank-card association runs the country's card/payments training and conference calendar (verified 2026 items: 'Zaklady kartoveho biznisu II - Vydavanie kariet' 8.9.2026, 'Akceptacia kariet' 10.9.2026, 'Bezpecnost platieb' 24.9.2026, 'Trendy v digitalnych platbach' 8.10.2026, 'Den bez hotovosti - Digitalna identita' 5.11.2026). Lecturers on these events are practising card/payments managers at SK banks and processors — the closest thing to a SK cards org-chart snapshot.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl of /podujatia plus each individual event detail page (listing page itself carries no speaker names — detail pages / PDF programmes must be followed); also crawl /aktualita news items.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk-language search on 'konferencia platobne karty Slovensko' then direct fetch of events page
queries_used: konferencia "platobne karty" OR "platobne systemy" Slovensko 2025 prednasajuci banka

candidates.source_name: Narodna banka Slovenska — Konferencie a podujatia
candidates.why_relevant: Central-bank hosted conferences (e.g. innovation/fintech conference held 28 Oct 2025) publish panel line-ups naming NBS section heads and commercial-bank executives; NBS titles are authoritative and change with reorganisations.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl event index + each event page and attached programme PDFs; extract speaker name/title/unit; also monitor the /en/ mirror.
queries_used: konferencia "platobne systemy" Slovensko 2025 prednasajuci banka

candidates.source_name: IBV NBS (Institut bankoveho vzdelavania NBS) — FinNext conference series
candidates.why_relevant: FinNext (spring edition 24 Mar 2026 on AML & Compliance; autumn edition from 5 Oct 2026) is the training arm of the central bank; its speaker lists are explicitly 'experts from practice and regulation — NBS representatives, leaders of major financial companies, fintech innovators', i.e. named compliance/AML/payments function holders. Also indicates which compliance functions banks are staffing up.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Twice-yearly scrape of the FinNext pages plus the course catalogue (/catalog/) — lecturer bios in the catalogue name individual bank specialists and their employers.
queries_used: IBV NBS konferencie 2026 platobne systemy prednasajuci

candidates.source_name: Slovenska bankova asociacia (SBA) — official site
candidates.why_relevant: Banking-association site is the natural host/announcer for a Slovak banking congress and for working-group membership; association project pages and press releases name bank representatives with function titles. Treat as pointer to congress/event pages that searches did not surface directly.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Full-site crawl incl. /projekty-a-standardy/ and the EN mirror /en/; watch for 'kongres', 'konferencia', 'podujatie' URL paths and press releases naming spokespeople.
candidates.discovered_via_method: sk-language search on 'kongres Slovenskej bankovej asociacie'
queries_used: kongres Slovenskej bankovej asociacie program recnici

candidates.source_name: Slovenska bankova asociacia — LinkedIn company page
candidates.why_relevant: Association posts event photos/announcements tagging attending bank executives with current titles; LinkedIn event pages for SK banking conferences also expose attendee/speaker identities. Strong cross-check for a title first seen on an agenda.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual analyst review only, or licensed data provider; do not scrape. Use to corroborate agenda-derived titles.
queries_used: kongres Slovenskej bankovej asociacie program recnici

candidates.why_relevant: Runs the recurring FINAS Meetup series (#14 on 26 Mar 2025, Pribinova 40 Bratislava; #17 bundled into Finweek 2026). Meetup pages and recaps name speakers from SK fintechs, payment institutions and banks — an early-signal source for new payments functions before they appear in press releases.

candidates.why_relevant: Predecessor/parallel association site (founded Aug 2018) aggregating SK fintech event announcements including banking-adjacent conferences; useful as a pointer feed to events not indexed by search engines.

candidates.source_name: Zlata minca — awards site (nominations + results)
candidates.why_relevant: 20-year-old SK financial-product award (2025 results announced 29 Oct 2025 at Hotel Tatra, day one of Finweek). Publishes per-category nomination and result tables (debit cards, credit cards, 13 banking categories) plus a 210-member expert jury whose members are named finance practitioners with employers — a large, dated roster of who works where. Also co-organises the Top Slovak Fintech Awards with FINAS.

candidates.source_name: TREND TOP — Banka roka (Slovak business weekly ranking/award)
candidates.why_relevant: TREND TOP names 'Banka roka' on financial indicators (VUB banka won for 2025) and runs an accompanying awards gala/conference where bank CEOs speak and are quoted with titles; TREND event coverage is a reliable dated marker of who represents each bank publicly.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated 'Kongres Slovenskej bankovej asociacie' (SBA banking congress) event page, programme or speaker roster could be located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searching 'kongres Slovenskej bankovej asociacie program recnici' in Slovak returned only the SBA corporate site, its Wikipedia entry, SBA Educa (exam body) and directory listings — no congress page. SBA may not run a public named congress, or it is announced only via LinkedIn/members-only channels.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief assumes a flagship SBA congress as a primary org-chart snapshot; if it does not exist publicly, Finweek and ZBK events must carry that role.

negative_findings.description: No Slovakia-hosted 'Banking Summit' was found; the term maps to foreign events.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bilingual search for 'banking summit' / 'bankovy summit' Slovensko 2026 returned only Future Banking Summit (Brasov, RO, 7-9 Oct 2026), European Banking Summit (28 Jan 2026), FT Global Banking Summit and vendor listicles. No SK-hosted equivalent surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: 'Banking Summit' is a noisy term for SK scouting; regional CEE summits (Brasov) should instead be mined for Slovak speakers rather than treated as SK sources.

negative_findings.description: No CEE/Central-Europe edition of the ICCOS cash-cycle seminar exists for 2026.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only EMEA (Cape Town, 30 Nov - 2 Dec 2026) and Americas editions are scheduled; ATMIA covers Europe via a Berlin/Madrid roadshow. No CEE-specific cash/ATM conference with a published SK speaker roster was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cash-cycle and ATM function holders in SK banks have no regional conference stage, so this function will stay under-observed by the events channel and needs a different source (tenders, vendor case studies).

negative_findings.description: ZBK events page publishes no speaker names on the listing page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetch of zbk.sk/podujatia returned five 2026 events with title/date/venue (Crowne Plaza Bratislava) but no lecturers, titles or agendas at listing level. Speaker data, if published, sits on per-event detail pages or PDF programmes not reachable from the listing excerpt.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must follow event detail pages and PDFs, not just the calendar, or the highest-value cards/payments name-title data will be missed.

negative_findings.description: No university career-fair exhibitor list for EUBA or STU Bratislava could be located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovak search for 'Den kariery Ekonomicka univerzita Bratislava STU vystavovatelia banky 2026' returned only university profile pages, catalogues and Wikipedia — no career-day page with an exhibitor roster. Such pages likely exist on faculty subdomains or Facebook events not indexed by the search engine used.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: University fairs are the cell's stated signal for graduate-pipeline expansion by banks; without exhibitor lists this sub-channel is currently unsourced.

negative_findings.description: The two richest people-level event sources are gated.
negative_findings.result_summary: LinkedIn (association pages, event attendee/speaker lists) is auth-walled with anti-scraping ToS; The Banker's Bank of the Year coverage is subscription-only. Both were reachable only through open mirrors (bank press releases, TASR/OTS).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Automated collection must route around them via press-release mirrors and manual analyst review, or title data will be incomplete and legally risky to gather.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed public SBA-run banking congress; the association's own event channel is unmapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl sbaonline.sk in full (SK + /en/) and the SBA LinkedIn feed manually for one annual cycle to determine whether a congress/annual conference exists and where it is announced; ask a SK-based analyst to confirm.

coverage_gaps.description: Event detail pages and programme PDFs (ZBK, IBV NBS, NBS) were not opened in this pass; only listing levels were confirmed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a second-level crawler that follows each event listing to its detail page and any attached PDF, and run OCR/text extraction to harvest name + title + employer triples.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical speaker rosters (needed for the year-over-year title diff that makes this cell valuable) were not located; organiser sites typically overwrite the current edition.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull archived editions from the Wayback Machine for finweek.sk/speakers, finweek.sk/program, zbk.sk/podujatia and zlataminca.sk result pages back to ~2018 to build the baseline title series.

coverage_gaps.description: University career fairs (EUBA, STU, UK, TUKE) are unsourced — no exhibitor lists found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search faculty subdomains (nhf.euba.sk, fiit.stuba.sk, fhi.euba.sk) and Facebook/LinkedIn event pages directly in Slovak ('den kariery', 'kariernie dni', 'burza prace', 'partneri podujatia'); consider the universities' career-centre pages as the entry point.

coverage_gaps.description: CEE regional conferences that host Slovak speakers (Future Banking Summit Brasov, Czech/Hungarian/Polish banking and card conferences) were only touched at the edge.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a CEE sweep covering CZ (e.g. Bankovnictvi/Card Forum), PL, HU and RO conference speaker pages, filtering for Slovak-employer affiliations — SK executives often appear abroad before at home.

coverage_gaps.description: ATM/cash-cycle and self-service function holders in SK have no regional conference stage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Substitute vendor/CIT channels: ATMIA member directories, Diebold/NCR/Printec case studies and SK public-procurement ATM tender documents, which name responsible managers.

brief: Slovakia's events channel for org-chart intelligence has one clear anchor and several reliable satellites: Finweek Bratislava (10th edition, 13-14 Oct 2026) publishes name + title + employer speaker cards that already include NBS section heads and Tatra banka staff, while ZBK (Zdruzenie pre bankove karty) runs the country's only dedicated cards/payments event calendar (five events Sep-Nov 2026 at Crowne Plaza Bratislava) and IBV NBS FinNext covers AML/compliance function holders twice a year. Awards form a parallel dated snapshot: Zlata minca (20 years, 210-member expert jury, 13 banking product categories) plus the Top Slovak Fintech Awards it co-runs with FINAS, and TREND TOP / The Banker 'Banka roka'. On the hiring side, Profesia Days Bratislava (22-23 Apr 2026) exhibitor lists and the AIESEC Narodne dni kariery / Kariera EXPO fairs show which employers are buying stands in SK. Two structural weaknesses: no public SBA banking congress could be found, and no CEE cash-cycle/ATM conference exists for 2026, so those functions stay invisible through events; also, listing pages rarely carry speaker names, so value depends on a second-level crawl of event detail pages and PDFs plus a Wayback backfill for year-over-year title diffs.
